entries.heading: EXTENSION OF LIMITATION ON EXCESS BUSINESS LOSSES OF NONCORPORATE TAXPAYERS
ancestors: Subtitle A—Crisis Support for Unemployed Workers
entries.text:
SEC. 9041. EXTENSION OF LIMITATION ON EXCESS BUSINESS LOSSES OF 
                          NONCORPORATE TAXPAYERS.

    (a) In General.--Section 461(l)(1) of the Internal Revenue Code of 
1986 is amended by striking ``January 1, 
2026'' each place it appears and inserting ``January 1, 2027''.
    (b) Effective Date.--The amendments made 
by this section shall apply to taxable years beginning after December 
31, 2025.
